title: Unit 3: Complete Key Vocabulary & Terminology (20 Words) 📚
content: 📌 Welcome Freshmen Students to Communicative English Skills II (EnLa102) - Unit 3! 👋✨ Here is the complete expanded vocabulary list for Unit 3: Environmental Protection , formatted in passage-based for your study and exam preparation. ─────────────────────────── 1. Transform (Verb) • English: To change completely in form, appearance, or character. • Amharic: ሙሉ በሙሉ መለወጥ/መቀየር • Synonyms: Alter, Convert, Metamorphose, Transfigure • Antonyms: Preserve, Maintain, Retain, Keep • Example: The hydro scheme transformed the dry, fertile country into lush farmland. ─────────────────────────── 2. Plummet (Verb) • English: To fall or drop straight down at high speed; to decrease very dramatically. • Amharic: በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ መውረድ/መቀነስ፣ ቁልቁል መከስከስ • Synonyms: Plunge, Drop, Collapse, Decline • Antonyms: Soar, Rise, Increase, Skyrocket • Example: Water inflow to the catchment area plummeted from 700 to 300 gigalitres in just one year. ─────────────────────────── 3. Refute (Verb) • English: To prove a statement or theory to be wrong; to reject with evidence. • Amharic: ማስተበል፣ ስህተት መሆኑን በምክንያት ማሳየት • Synonyms: Disprove, Rebut, Contradict, Deny • Antonyms: Confirm, Prove, Support, Validate • Example: Local farmers refute the claim that current drought conditions are purely caused by climate change. ─────────────────────────── 4. Rampant (Adjective) • English: Flourishing or spreading unchecked, especially something unwelcome or harmful. • Amharic: ቁጥጥር የሌለው፣ በስፋት የተንሰራፋ/የተዛመተ • Synonyms: Uncontrolled, Unrestrained, Widespread, Pervasive • Antonyms: Controlled, Restrained, Limited, Moderate • Example: Environmentalists argue that rampant land-clearing has accelerated ecological destruction. ─────────────────────────── 5. Acute (Adjective) • English: Present or experienced to a severe or intense degree; very serious. • Amharic: አጣዳፊ፣ በጽኑ የሚጎዳ/በጣም ከባድ • Synonyms: Severe, Critical, Drastic, Intense • Antonyms: Mild, Slight, Minor, Moderate • Example: The effect of prolonged water shortages on rural farming towns is extremely acute. ─────────────────────────── 6. Eerily (Adverb) • English: In a strange, frightening, or mysterious manner. • Amharic: በሚያስፈራ/በሚያስደነግጥ ሁኔታ ጸጥ ያለ • Synonyms: Strangely, Creepily, Uncannily, Ghostly • Antonyms: Normally, Cheerfully, Comfortingly • Example: The streets of the drought-stricken rural town were eerily quiet in the evening. ─────────────────────────── 7. Deforestation (Noun) • English: The large-scale clearing or removal of trees from a forest area without replanting. • Amharic: የደን ጭፍጨፋ/ምንጠራ • Synonyms: Forest clearance, Logging, Tree-felling • Antonyms: Afforestation, Reforestation, Forest conservation • Example: Deforestation causes severe soil erosion and contributes to global climate disruption. ─────────────────────────── 8. Desertification (Noun) • English: The process by which fertile land degrades and becomes desert. • Amharic: በረሃማነት/መሬት ወደ በረሃነት መቀየር • Synonyms: Land degradation, Aridity, Soil depletion • Antonyms: Land reclamation, Greening, Soil restoration • Example: Uncontrolled overgrazing and tree removal are major human drivers of desertification. ─────────────────────────── 9. Ozone Depletion (Noun Phrase) • English: The gradual thinning of Earth's protective ozone layer due to chemical pollutants. • Amharic: የኦዞን ንጣፍ መሸርሸር/መቀነስ • Synonyms: Ozone degradation, Ozone layer damage • Antonyms: Ozone restoration, Ozone layer preservation • Example: Ozone depletion increases the amount of harmful ultraviolet radiation reaching the Earth. ─────────────────────────── 10. Acid Rain (Noun Phrase) • English: Precipitation made unusually acidic by atmospheric industrial pollution. • Amharic: አሲዳማ ዝናብ • Synonyms: Acidic precipitation, Polluted rain • Antonyms: Pure precipitation, Clean rain • Example: Acid rain damages aquatic ecosystems, corrodes buildings, and destroys forest foliage. ─────────────────────────── 11. Loss of Biodiversity (Noun Phrase) • English: The decline or extinction of biological diversity among living organisms and species. • Amharic: የብዝሃ-ሕይወት መጥፋት/መቀነስ • Synonyms: Species extinction, Ecosystem collapse, Biological impoverishment • Antonyms: Biodiversity conservation, Ecological preservation • Example: The drying up of river ecosystems leads to a catastrophic loss of biodiversity. ─────────────────────────── 12. Urban Sprawl (Noun Phrase) • English: The rapid, uncontrolled expansion of urban areas into surrounding rural lands. • Amharic: የከተሞች ያልተመጠነ/ያልተቆጣጠሩት ስፋት • Synonyms: Urban expansion, Suburban sprawl, Unchecked development • Antonyms: Urban consolidation, Smart growth, Compact development • Example: Rapid urban sprawl reduces natural wildlife habitats and consumes valuable agricultural land. ─────────────────────────── 13. Drought (Noun) • English: A prolonged period of abnormally low rainfall leading to severe water shortages. • Amharic: ድርቅ/የዝናብ እጥረት • Synonyms: Dry spell, Aridity, Water shortage, Lack of rain • Antonyms: Flood, Deluge, Heavy rainfall • Example: The severe natural drought combined with water over-allocation caused the river basin to dry out. ─────────────────────────── 14. Overfishing (Noun) • English: The depletion of fish populations in a body of water by excessive fishing. • Amharic: ከልክ በላይ ዓሣ ማጥመድ • Synonyms: Overharvesting, Marine resource depletion • Antonyms: Sustainable fishing, Marine conservation • Example: Overfishing in river ecosystems threatens aquatic life and destroys balanced food chains. ─────────────────────────── 15. Greenhouse Effect (Noun Phrase) • English: The trapping of heat in the atmosphere by greenhouse gases leading to global warming. • Amharic: የሙቀት አማቂ ጋዞች ውጤት (ግሪንሃውስ ኤፌክት) • Synonyms: Thermal trapping, Atmospheric warming • Antonyms: Atmospheric cooling, Heat radiation • Example: The greenhouse effect causes global temperatures to rise and disrupts weather patterns. ─────────────────────────── 16. Deteriorating (Adjective) • English: Becoming progressively worse in condition or quality. • Amharic: እየተበላሸ/እየቀነሰ የሚሄድ • Synonyms: Declining, Worsening, Degenerating, Decaying • Antonyms: Improving, Flourishing, Recovering • Example: The black box eucalyptus trees are stark indicators of the region's deteriorating health. ─────────────────────────── 17. Dwindling (Adjective) • English: Gradually diminishing in size, amount, or strength. • Amharic: እየቀነሰ/እየተመናመነ የሚሄድ • Synonyms: Shrinking, Diminishing, Decreasing, Lessening • Antonyms: Growing, Increasing, Expanding • Example: Livelihoods depending on the dwindling flow of the river are severely threatened. ─────────────────────────── 18. Sceptic (Noun) • English: A person who questions or doubts accepted opinions or claims. • Amharic: ተጠራጣሪ፣ ሀሳብን/መረጃን በቀላሉ የማይቀበል • Synonyms: Doubter, Questioner, Disbeliever • Antonyms: Believer, Devotee, Supporter • Example: Many farmers were global warming sceptics who pointed to historical weather cycles. ─────────────────────────── 19. Longevity (Noun) • English: Long duration of individual life or long continuance of something. • Amharic: ረጅም ዕድሜ/ረጅም ጊዜ መቆየት • Synonyms: Endurance, Permanence, Durability, Long life • Antonyms: Shortness, Transience, Ephemerality • Example: The increased suicide rate was attributed to the drought's longevity and uncertainty. ─────────────────────────── 20. Whittle (Verb) • English: To reduce something in size, amount, or number by a series of gradual steps. • Amharic: ቀስ በቀስ መቀነስ/መሸርሸር • Synonyms: Reduce, Trim, Pare down, Cut back • Antonyms: Increase, Expand, Augment • Example: The severe drought whittled 1% off the national economy in a single year. ─────────────────────────── ❤️ Dear EthioFresh Students!
